Who would have thought that something akin to a ball of electricity could be skinned. The skin from a poltergeist is rather heavy, rough and dry in touch, making it uncomfortable to wear. Even though the creature is dead, its skin still emits a small field, thus stopping moderate amounts of physical damage, while also making the wearer more vulnerable to heat and electrical currents.
